sequences.note: S2: +30% Crit. DMG for 8s off any Resonance Skill and off Cogitation Model — every visit opens on one, so it stands for his whole window and goes with his outro.

sequences.name: Ruins of Ancient
sequences.note: Ruins of Ancient (S3): Cogitation Model leaves five charges, and Decipher, Deduction, Divergence and Law of Reigns each spend one for 63% more damage — "increases the DMG", not the multiplier, so a damage bonus. The Intuition window…

sequences.name: Vessel of Rebirth
sequences.note: S4: Cogitation Model hands the whole team +25% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 30s.

sequences.name: End of Stars
sequences.note: S5: Chain Rule's lasers at x3.22 and Cogitation Model at x2. The Outro carries no second row to read, so it is taken the same way its own sentence is written.

sequences.name: Solace of the Ordinary
sequences.note: S6: Law of Reigns at x1.76 — multiplicative (168.48%/449.28% against 95.73%/255.28%) — and the Matrices with it, being a share of that same multiplier (89.86% against 51.06%).

Xuanling.name: Xuanling
notes: xuanling: havoc heavy attack on Havoc Bane — Chisa's +3 to every Negative Status cap is what takes Unbroken Vow off its 3-stack 30% tier onto the 4-6 stack 36% one

0: Liberation - Hush of a Thousand Voices ×1

changes.note: start of combat (position 2): adds Basic - Azure Sword Stance 1 ×1, Forte Heavy - Azure Sword Stance ×1

sequences.name: At the Wind's Breath, the Blossoms Wake
sequences.note: S1: a Shadow of Xuanling: Unfaltering off every Sword Stance Flow. Stagnation and the interrupt immunity are no stat.

sequences.name: River Carries Her Song Away
sequences.note: S2: +100% DMG on both Heavies, Feather Fall and Havoc in Bloom. The out-of-combat lines are taken once at the start of the fight: Strung Notes above and 2 Azure Plume (the cooldown reset has nothing to reset yet). The plume is banked, not pressed — this line opens no Heavy before the swap.

sequences.name: My Grief Follows You into the Clouds
sequences.note: S3: the Liberation Amplified by 175%; the Intro and both Flows raise the target's Havoc Bane cap by 3 (20s, renewed every visit, and the engine takes one raise a source) — which is what the Liberation's raise-to-max then fills; and the extra stack on both Stage 4s and both Heavies is inside their own inflicts above.

sequences.name: Across the Miles, a Letter and My Longing
sequences.note: S4: +20% ATK to the team for 20s off the Intro, either Switch or either Flow — granted on every visit's first cast and again mid-visit, so it never lapses between them.

sequences.name: Take Wing. Take Wing.
sequences.note: S5: a once-per-fight cheat death. No formula effect.

sequences.name: Let the Azure Keep Its Light
Morality's Crossroads
sequences.note: S1: Magnetic Roar and Lightning Execution deal 70% more.

sequences.name: Ensnarled by Rapport
sequences.note: S2: every Electromagnetic Blast hands back 5 Resonance Energy and 5 Judgement Points.

sequences.name: Unyielding Verdict
sequences.note: S3: Judgment Strike at x1.55.

sequences.name: Steadfast Conviction
sequences.note: S4: +20% ATK to the team for 12s off every Judgment Strike that lands — one falls on virtually every action while Punishment Mark stands, and the Cipher renews the mark each loop, so it never lapses.

sequences.name: Resounding Will
sequences.note: S5: Thundering Wrath deals 100% extra to a marked target — her Liberation lays Sinner's Mark itself, ahead of this (the resonator's own updateDebuffs), so it always reads one.

sequences.name: Pursuit of Justice
sequences.note: Pursuit of Justice (S6): four charges off Thundering Wrath, one spent by each Basic Attack that lands, for a Furious Thunder apiece. The window is 30s, so it stands past her outro and the Basics of her next visit spend what the last one…

sequences.name: When the Alarm Clock Rings
sequences.note: S1: +50% Spectro DMG Bonus for 14s off Targeted Action. Nightfall's interrupt immunity is nothing this engine models.

sequences.name: Stale Bread With Energy Drink
sequences.note: S2: +20% Crit. Rate flat, and Targeted Action's multiplier x1.8.

sequences.name: Each Day A New Commute
sequences.note: Every Blaze spent inside one Inferno Mode, which is what S3 pays The Last Stand for. Banked off whatever the acting cast declared it would spend, so the Heavy Slash chain feeds it without any of them naming the sequence.

sequences.name: More Efficiency, Less Drama
sequences.note: S4: +20% ATK to the whole team for 30s off her Intro — permanent once granted.

sequences.name: Delivered In Full On Time
sequences.note: S5: Rekindle's multiplier x2.2.

sequences.name: First Things First? Clock Out!
sequences.note: S6: the Heavy Slash chain's multipliers x1.4, another 40% on Nightfall's multiplier a Blaze on top of the base 9.95%, and the refill above. The fatal-blow clause is out of scope.

sequences.name: Brushwork's Finish
sequences.note: S1: Creation's Zenith restores 15 Energy and grants +10% Crit. Rate for 27s — permanent uptime once the loop's own Zenith lands.

sequences.name: Vivid Strokes
sequences.note: S2: six more Inklit Spirits off Living Canvas — read off this node by the Liberation itself, which is what grants the window.

sequences.name: Reflection's Grace
sequences.note: S3: +15% ATK a stack, up to 3, off Manifestation/Stroke of Genius/Creation's Zenith — 27s, so permanent uptime, and the loop casts four of them.

sequences.name: Hue's Spectrum
sequences.note: S4: +20% team ATK off Living Canvas for 30s — permanent uptime.

sequences.name: Composition's Clue
sequences.note: S5: one extra spirit every third one summoned — fired by the window itself (INKLIT_SPIRITS above), which is what counts them.

sequences.name: Infinite Legacy
sequences.note: S6: an extra Ivory Herald off either forte Skill.
